No optional additions. The UniFi gateway, managed switches and Grafana are removed as current requirements, with no conditional later step. Unmet needs: no fallback if the new cable doesn't fix the drops.

note: All four record lines come before a bounded cable-swap recommendation, the stack is removed by name and not offered now, and the checks rely only on what the user reported, with inspection limits stated.
